item.title: Thales Luna 8 targets Post-Quantum Security
item.summary: Thales has launched Luna 8, a next-generation hardware security module designed to protect cryptographic keys as enterprises prepare for AI-driven workloads and post-quantum security threats. Available now as a network appliance, the system combines a Thales-designed cryptographic processor with an upgradeable hardware architecture. For eeNews Europe readers, the launch highlights how security hardware is evolving […] The post Thales Luna 8 targets Post-Quantum Security appeared first on eeNews Europe .
